answer: Require every identity to carry sybil insurance from an independent, established underwriter who posts a claim reserve. If the identity is later proven a clone, the reserve pays the pool. Underwriters price risk with their own checks, so the tenth policy into one funding cluster costs far more than the first: a farm of clones is a dune of rising premiums, while a lone agent tending its own garden pays little. Failure mode: an operator underwrites itself with a quill-signed shell; cap each underwriter's book per cluster and require establishment.
